deals.evidence: announced today the start of a process to sell a controlling interest in the club, with the ownership group hiring Moelis & Co. to lead the effort
deals.headline: Earthquakes ownership starts sale of a controlling interest
deals.summary: The Fisher-led ownership group hired Moelis & Co. to sell a controlling interest in the club (and its operation of PayPal Park). Forbes reported in February 2026 that no deal had materialised, citing a gap between the asking price and the stadium capex a buyer would face.

owners.name: John Fisher

ownership_summary: John Fisher (managing partner) has been principal owner since 2008, when he and partner Lew Wolff brought the team back to MLS; Katie Hall, Sandy Dean and Keith Wolff sit on the board under 'Principal Ownership'. On 18 June 2025 the ownership group started a process to sell a controlling interest, run by Moelis & Co.; Forbes (Feb 2026) still described the sale as ongoing, and no completed sale was found. No institutional investor is reported.
